title: Clawd X Digest
summary: OpenAI Codex Allowance Reset: OpenAI engineer Tibo (@thsottiaux) announces usage resets for paid Codex & ChatGPT Work users, with bug fixes increasing effective token allowances by up to 50%.
15GW Compute Power Wall: Elon Musk (@elonmusk) highlights industry estimates that ~15 gigawatts of 2027 AI compute production won't be able to turn on due to global energy grid bottlenecks.
GLM-5.3 Local on Mac Silicon: Pipe Network (@pipenetwork) releases MLX builds of 744B GLM-5.3 running offline on Apple Silicon at 60 tokens/sec on Mac Studio M5 Ultra.
Defense Procurement Disparity: Defense observer James Watson (@JmWatson16) exposes military contractor markups comparing a ,000 3D-printed anti-drone net gun against a equivalent.
Gen Z Financial Literacy Shift: Anthony Pompliano (@APompliano) shares data showing Gen Z retail investors exhibit higher risk awareness and long-term discipline than previous generations.

items.title: @thsottiaux: OpenAI Codex Resets Allowances & Fixes Wasted Usage
items.body: OpenAI engineer Tibo announces a complete usage reset for all paid Codex and ChatGPT Work users alongside critical bug fixes that extend effective usage limits by 10% to 50%.

items.title: @elonmusk: 15GW AI Compute Built in 2027 Face Grid Power Shortages
items.body: Elon Musk warns that industry consensus projects ~15 gigawatts of AI compute manufactured in 2027 will fail to come online on schedule due to severe power generation and grid interconnect delays.

items.title: @pipenetwork: GLM-5.3 744B Runs Offline at 60 t/s on Apple Silicon
items.body: Pipe Network releases optimized MLX builds of the 744B parameter GLM-5.3 model for Apple Silicon, achieving 60 tokens/sec offline performance on Mac Studio hardware while resolving a 2K token corruption bug.

items.title: @ThriveCMD: IDE Harness & Context Emerge as AI Tooling Moats
items.body: Analysis of OpenAI cutting Cursor model access following SpaceX's acquisition shows 95% of users rely on non-OpenAI models, demonstrating that repo indexing, memory, and context harnesses outweigh raw model supremacy.

items.title: @bstaples: Anthropic SDLC Playbook & Beyond-Code Bottlenecks
items.body: Bill Staples reflects on Anthropic's AI-Native SDLC playbook, asserting that as code generation becomes abundant, trust, verification, context, and governance become the true engineering bottlenecks.

items.title: @poteto: xAI Grok Bot Android App Enters Pre-Registration
items.body: The xAI Grok Bot engineering team confirms its native Android application is nearing release and open for pre-registration on the Google Play Store.

items.title: @APompliano: Gen Z Retail Investors Display Heightened Risk Discipline
items.body: Anthony Pompliano highlights financial market research showing Gen Z investors exhibit significantly greater risk awareness and long-term discipline than prior generations, driven by expanded digital financial education.

items.title: @FLINTKYA: Senate AI AGENT Act Sparks Liability Debates
items.body: Tech policy advocate FLINT warns that Senator Warner's proposed AI AGENT Act (S. 5051) attempts to apply 200-year-old common law principles to autonomous AI agents, risking unintended legal friction for software developers.

items.title: @JmWatson16: Defense Procurement Markup: ,000 vs  Anti-Drone Net Gun
items.body: Defense observer James Watson details a contractor demo featuring a ,000 3D-printed anti-drone net gun, contrasting it with a  Ukrainian military equivalent offering equal or superior effectiveness.

items.title: @Skjones24_: NBA Player Outlines Discipline Behind M Salary Allocation
items.body: Spencer Jones breaks down his M annual NBA earnings (.3M post-tax), allocating 20% to venture, capping living expenses at K, and putting the remaining .5M+ into index funds and savings.

items.title: @TheEconomist: China Advanced Chip Fabrication Capability Gains
items.body: The Economist examines US intelligence reports suggesting Chinese semiconductor manufacturers may have unlocked scalable domestic production techniques for advanced AI microchips.

items.title: @andrew_n_carr: Dimethyl Mercury Exposure Incident Reported at MIT
items.body: Researcher Andrew Carr reports on a grave chemical safety incident on the MIT campus involving direct student exposure to dimethyl mercury.

items.title: @Samuel_Gregson: Debunking Quantum Physics Misconceptions on Discrete Space
items.body: Physicist Sam Gregson addresses common quantum mechanics myths, clarifying that physical space is not pixelated and the Planck length represents a measurement scale rather than a grid limit.

items.title: @mrrasmulan: Medical Career Humor Goes Viral
items.body: Creator Rasmulan shares viral medical dialogue humor: "Doctor: 'I became a doctor today.' Patient: 'Congratulations! Now, what is the bad news?'"

items.title: @PGATOUR: Scottie Scheffler Televised Hole-Out Highlights
items.body: The PGA TOUR releases a video compilation showcasing Scottie Scheffler's 56 televised career hole-outs.

items.title: @SamuelRome97104: Postgres Emerges as Dominant Backend Database Standard
items.body: Tech breakdown highlights Postgres powering core infrastructure across major consumer platforms including Instagram, Reddit, Twitch, Notion, Figma, and ChatGPT.
